atoms.text: There were only a few citizens of Oscuridad that showed appreciation for Alonso’s ambitious quest. However, this did not bother him at all. He worked tirelessly and kept pursuing his plan to leave the dark days behind.

instruction.text: Match the words with a similar meaning.

atoms.text: After countless days in his workshop, he finally found a way to store sunlight. He invented a device that could save rays of sunlight and was able to release them when they were most needed. Thanks to Alonso’s courage and persistence, the dark days of Oscudirad were over and a bright future lay ahead of it.
